summary: Austria's pledges combine ecosystem restoration and conservation with agricultural and land-sector measures. For conservation, Austria's LULUCF commitment is -879 Kt CO2eq by 2030, within an EU carbon-sinks goal of -310 Mt CO2-eq (310 Mt of net removals), including 42 Mt CO2-eq more removals than the 2016-2018 average; these are carbon-sink rather than hectare targets. Restoration is framed at EU level, with measures covering at least 20% of EU land and 20% of EU seas by 2030; no Austria-specific restoration area is stated, despite forests covering 52.9% of Austria and grasslands 16.9%. Mixed measures also include a EUR 243 million LIFE package. For agriculture, 40% of the EU CAP allocation should contribute to climate objectives, 25% of annual Pillar I direct-payment funds is earmarked for eco-schemes, and 35% of Pillar II funds supports environmental and climate activities; these are funding shares, not coverage of Austria's 22.9% agricultural land.
